scope: Current public mostly-off catalog selection and output hashes versus both frozen released and pinned-development source witnesses; not all-features, Java, JAR or gameplay acceptance.

commands.selection: sfm-propagate-changes --output-format json source project dry-run --repo-root <checked repository> --projection <exact catalog key>
commands.ignored_report_capture_files: Bounded goal-owned diagnostic captures only; no projection output writes.
commands.tree: git -c protocol.allow=never -c core.fsmonitor=false ls-tree -r <exact pinned commit> -- platform/minecraft/src
commands.blob: git -c protocol.allow=never -c core.fsmonitor=false cat-file --batch (only verified fixed OIDs)
commands.hash: sfm-propagate-changes --output-format json hash file platform/minecraft/projections.json --algorithm blake3 --length 20

executable.usage: Copied default-features proof executable, not installed freshness

excluded_housekeeping.classification: Frozen tracked datagen .cache housekeeping deliberately omitted, not a shipped-artifact or packaging acceptance claim.

development_extras.actual_enabled_owner: client_actions OR touch_display_terminal_mount as actual enabled consumers
client_actions OR touch_display_terminal_mount as actual enabled consumers

development_omission_contract: Public dev entries do not represent frozen all-features development trees. Both inventories and exact missing sets are reported; omissions are not silently accepted as all-features parity or repaired with historical production overrides.

content_comparison_contract.no_own_template_expander: Output hashes and lengths came from the actual copied CLI. Historical candidates only add the known banner or exact bounded newline transforms; no independent Liquid expansion was substituted.
content_comparison_contract.unreviewed_content_difference: Exact body plus banner and the bounded normalization candidates do not match. Kept explicit, including intentional mostly-off versus historical development differences; no semantic equivalence asserted.
content_comparison_contract.java_generated_banner_only: Frozen raw Java bytes plus the exact registered generated banner and selected authored-template newline, with BOM position preserved; no body normalization.
content_comparison_contract.pinned_normalized_body_equal: Diagnostic candidate CRLF-to-LF and/or exactly one missing final LF reproduced the actual reported output hash/length and the exact normalized body SHA256 is bound with the raw SHA256 in an existing reviewed ledger object. No generic normalization permission inferred.
content_comparison_contract.assertion_identity: initial_comparison_sha256 binds the original diagnostic assertion before reviewed-ledger references were added; initial_content_manifest_sha256 uses those initial comparison IDs.
content_comparison_contract.raw_body_equal: Exact full-file output hash/length equals raw frozen Git bytes.

digest_contracts.paths: SHA256 of ordinal-sorted UTF8 path lines, each with terminal LF.
digest_contracts.artifacts: SHA256 of ordinal-sorted UTF8 output_path<TAB>authored_input<TAB>source_sha256<TAB>output_sha256<TAB>output_bytes lines, each with terminal LF.
digest_contracts.core_manifest: SHA256 of ordinal-sorted repository-relative core_path<TAB>sha256<TAB>bytes lines, each with terminal LF.
digest_contracts.tree: SHA256 of ordinal-sorted UTF8 path<TAB>OID lines, each with terminal LF.
digest_contracts.initial_content: SHA256 of ordinal-sorted path<TAB>frozen_OID<TAB>actual_output_SHA256<TAB>initial_comparison_SHA256 lines, each with terminal LF.
digest_contracts.path_set: SHA256 of sorted decimal path-table indices separated by comma, followed by one LF.

normalization_evidence.scope: Exact hash-binding to an existing reviewed source ledger; not a new blanket whitespace authorization or JAR acceptance.

limits.capture_bound: CLI output cap checked after asynchronous capture, not a hostile-output hard streaming bound.
limits.source_freeze_released_after: Final full-core/metadata/executable after-manifest remained identical; portable ledger assembled from frozen captures only.
limits.content_scope: src inputs only; selected Gradle/project-file metadata identities are pinned but their historical build contents are not claimed equivalent here.
limits.root_concurrent_activity: Root-owned Rust gate and separately authorized native Forge validation ran independently. Those are not effects or acceptance results of this audit.
